---
name: Feature request
about: Suggest a change to the examples, documentation or build process.
title: "[Feature]: "
labels: enhancement
---

## What would you like to change?

Describe the behaviour, example or documentation you would like to see.

## Why would it be useful?

Explain the problem this change would solve or the task it would make easier.

## Suggested approach

Describe one possible solution. A specific file path or example is helpful.

## Alternatives considered

Mention any other approach you considered, or write "None".

## Additional context

Screenshots and small synthetic examples are welcome. Do not include private client material or credentials.
